_comment: Drop this file as kafka-publisher-broker.json alongside your app. It overrides ONLY the Kafka broker connection settings on top of routes/design config that already exist in your code. No code changes needed — just wrap your existing provider: new JsonKafkaPublisherBrokerOverrideProvider(existingProvider)

security._comment: Sensitive values use ${ENV_VAR_NAME} placeholders (env vars), or pass a MicrosoftConfigurationSecretResolver to pull from Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, etc.
